text: Now that you own a very visible volcano lair, you need an evil army to guard it. Congratulations, you are now a stressed-out human resources manager.

Suppose you hire one hundred full-time guards, technicians, and lab assistants. Even at modest pay with overtime, payroll, workers compensation, and dental insurance easily burns through nine million dollars every single year.

If you try to cut corners with minimum-wage henchmen, loyalty drops straight through the floor. Nobody is diving in front of a laser beam for seventeen dollars an hour without paid vacation and a retirement match.

Worse, background checks are nearly impossible when your job posting asks for experience guarding doomsday devices. Within one week, forty-seven bored guards are livestreaming your secret laser hallway on TikTok for free views.
Your feared underground syndicate does not get defeated by a secret agent. It collapses because half your staff quit over a broken breakroom coffee machine.
